primitives.name: Distance Map Formulation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equations & assumptions Distance map (faithful to paper): D_t(x,y) = ||V_{0→t}(x,y)|| · cos θ / ||V_{0→1}(x,y)|| where V_{0→t} is the motion field from frame 0 to intermediate time t, V_{0→1} the full inter-frame motion, and θ the angle between them.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_t(x,y)': 'Dimensionless spatial coordinate', 'V_{0→t}(x,y)': 'Pixel displacement per temporal step', 'V_{0→1}(x,y)': 'Pixel displacement per frame interval', 'θ': 'Radians'}
primitives.assumptions: (a) Motion between frames is well described by dense optical-flow fields; (b) the scalar distance ratio resolves the directional ambiguity; (c) CPFlow maps are sufficiently accurate references for iteration; (d) PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/NIQE improvements correspond to perceptually better interpolation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when V_{0→1} → 0 (static frames) or θ → π/2 (orthogonal motion components).

layer2.mapping: Maps the geometric optics problem onto a probabilistic transport equation. The distance map D_t(x,y) corresponds to the optimal coupling coefficient in a Wasserstein-1 flow between probability distributions of pixel intensities at times t and t+1.
layer2.telemetry: Empirical verification via kernel density estimates of interpolated frames.

primitives.name: Iterative Reference-Based Estimation
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Multi-frame refiner: uses several input frames plus the estimated distance map to synthesize the target frame.
primitives.assumptions: (a) Convergence of the iterative scheme; (b) availability of high-quality reference frames.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when reference frames contain occlusions or large displacements beyond the optical-flow range.

layer2.mapping: Reduces to a fixed-point iteration of a contraction mapping in the Banach space of distance functions. Each refinement step minimizes a data-fidelity term weighted by the gradient of the reference image.
layer2.telemetry: Number of iterations required for sub-pixel accuracy in the distance map.

primitives.name: Multi-Frame Refiner
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Multi-frame refiner: uses several input frames plus the estimated distance map to synthesize the target frame.
primitives.assumptions: (a) Temporal coherence across multiple frames; (b) linear superposition of motion contributions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates to nearest-neighbor interpolation when the distance map approaches a delta function.

layer2.mapping: Maps the multi-frame synthesis into a convolutional neural network with learnable filters that operate on a spatio-temporal feature volume. The distance map acts as a soft attention mask.
layer2.telemetry: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) improvement relative to single-frame baseline.

By introducing a distance map D_t that encodes arc-length parametrization along the flow line, we convert the non-convex interpolation problem into a convex optimization over a latent variable. The iterative estimation updates these potentials via Richardson iteration, guaranteeing convergence under Lipschitz continuity of the optical-flow operator. The multi-frame refiner then solves a linear system of constraints enforced by the refined distance map, producing sharp edges through total-variation regularization.
